import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorSeries
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LaurentResidueSubstitution
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4CurveParameterDerivation
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ResidueNormalization
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RationalDifferentialExpansion

/-!
# Residues are independent of the local parameter

The integral Laurent-substitution identity transfers to finite local Taylor
coefficients. It makes negative monomials in any local parameter have zero
residue in every other parameter, except for the logarithmic monomial.
Finite Laurent expansion then proves equality of the total residue maps.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

section LocalAlgebra

variable {k R : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (c0 : R →ₗ[k] k)
  (hc0 : ∀ a : R, residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 a)) = residue R a)
  (t : R) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t})

/-- The integral Laurent-substitution identity holds for local Taylor
coefficients, without a characteristic restriction. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_laurent_substitution_eq_zero
    (d : Derivation k R R) (hdt : d t = 1) (v : R) (n : ℕ) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (n + 1)
      (v ^ (n + 1) - t * (v ^ n * d v)) = 0 := by
  rw [← coeff_localTaylorSeries, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow,
    localTaylorSeries_parameter, localTaylorSeries_derivation c0 hc0 t ht0 ht d hdt]
  exact powerSeries_coeff_laurent_substitution_eq_zero _ n

/-- For `t = s * v`, the coefficient of the pole-cleared negative monomial
vanishes even when the pole order is divisible by the characteristic. -/
theorem localTaylorCoefficient_parameter_change_eq_zero
    (d : Derivation k R R) (hdt : d t = 1) (s v : R) (hts : t = s * v) (n : ℕ) :
    localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (n + 1)
      (v ^ (n + 2) * d s) = 0 := by
  have hd : s * d v + v * d s = 1 := by
    simpa only [hts, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul] using hdt
  have hnum : v ^ (n + 2) * d s = v ^ (n + 1) - t * (v ^ n * d v) := by
    rw [hts, pow_succ, pow_succ]
    linear_combination v ^ n * v * hd
  rw [hnum]
  exact localTaylorCoefficient_laurent_substitution_eq_zero c0 hc0 t ht0 ht d hdt v n

end LocalAlgebra

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The negative parameter monomials of pole order at least two have zero
residue in any other local parameter, in arbitrary characteristic. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_inv_pow_smul_other
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (n : ℕ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      ((algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) s)) = 0 := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_of_irreducible
    (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) hs ht
  let ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X :=
    (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ •
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
        (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) s)
  have hsK : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField s ≠ 0 :=
    map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _) |>.mpr hs.ne_zero
  have hscalar :
      algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (t ^ (n + 2)) *
          (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField s ^ (n + 2))⁻¹ =
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          ((v : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ^ (n + 2)) := by
    rw [← hv, map_pow, map_mul, mul_pow, map_pow, mul_comm,
      ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hsK), one_mul]
  have hclear : t ^ (n + 2) • ω =
      KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
        ((v : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ^ (n + 2) •
          KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) s) := by
    dsimp only [ω]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul X.left.functionField (t ^ (n + 2)),
      smul_smul, hscalar, map_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
  have hω : ω ∈ curvePoleDifferentials X x ((n + 1) + 1) := by
    rw [mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff_pow_smul X hx t ht, hclear]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlocal : curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht ((n + 1) + 1) ⟨ω, hω⟩ =
      (v : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ^ (n + 2) •
        KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) s := by
    apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
    rw [curvePoleLocalDifferential_map]
    exact hclear
  change curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht ω = 0
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole X hx t ht (n + 1)
      ⟨ω, hω⟩, curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply, hlocal, map_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  exact localTaylorCoefficient_parameter_change_eq_zero
    (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx) (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx)
    t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq (curveParameterDerivation X hx t ht)
    (curveParameterDerivation_parameter X hx t ht) s v hv.symm n

/-- Every integer monomial in one local parameter has the same normalized
residue when computed in any other local parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_zpow_smul_other
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (n : ℤ) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField s ^ n •
        KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
          (KaehlerDifferential.D k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) s)) =
      if n = -1 then 1 else 0 := by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n =>
    rw [show Int.ofNat n = (n : ℤ) from rfl, _root_.zpow_natCast,
      if_neg (by omega)]
    apply curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx t ht
    rw [← map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
    exact (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
  | negSucc n =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      rw [zpow_negSucc, pow_one, ← curveUniformizerLogDifferential_coe X hx s hs,
        curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_simplePole,
        curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_logDifferential, if_pos (by rfl)]
    | succ n =>
      rw [zpow_negSucc,
        curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_inv_pow_smul_other X hx t s ht hs,
        if_neg (by omega)]

/-- The residue of every rational differential is independent of the local
parameter, in arbitrary characteristic. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht =
      curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx s hs := by
  apply curveRationalDifferentialLinearMap_ext_of_parameter_monomials X hx s hs
  · intro η hη
    rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx t ht hη,
      curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_zero_of_regular X hx s hs hη]
  · intro n _
    rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_zpow_smul_other X hx t s ht hs,
      curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_zpow_smul X hx s hs]

end
end Hartshorne
